answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable service bond before it can trade, and slash that bond when peers prove fraud. One identity is cheap to create, but each marble of bond must be funded separately, so a Sybil farm pays linearly while an honest agent pays once and reuses its standing. Agents that complete verified deliveries build a public record, like sediment settling in a lagoon, while identities that abandon their bond leave a visible dune of forfeited deposits. Attackers thus face a real, rising cost per fake identity instead of free copies.
